scope: historical research only; no account orders

trend.rule: positive trailing close return -> enter 95% long once; negative -> exit; no same-state rebalancing

reversion.rule: log-close z against previous window excluding current; 1 entry, no averaging down; stop at entry minus prior ATR multiple

grid.rule: equal cash per independent cell, initial upper cells bought at episode initialization; one pre-existing order fill per cell per hour; strict 2bps penetration; fixed episode bounds; close outside bounds or scheduled reset -> flatten then reanchor

breakout.rule: prior-window high-low/mean close <=12%; completed close breaks prior high/low -> long/short; exit 10bar opposite channel or 30bar timeout; 3ATR stop; underlying price proxy not certified perpetual PnL

constant_mix.rule: once daily rebalance only if allocation differs by >5 percentage points; no borrowing

clock.execution: first hourly open >= decision bar end + 1 hour
clock.historical_available_at: unknown; 1h execution lag is explicit assumption
clock.intrabar_stop: gap through stop executes at worse opening price, otherwise stop price; market cost added; stop active immediately after market entry

research_account.rules_note: current product rule snapshot imposed as research scenario, not certified historical venue rules; reference NAV is research unit, no funds deployed

splits_utc.walk_forward_selection: for each test year, select family variant by previous 2 completed calendar years of daily Sharpe at base cost; primary wins exact tie; flat reinitialization at test start charged costs; warmup only for features
splits_utc.sealed_selection: freeze chosen family variant from 2024-2025 training score before reading sealed strategy results
splits_utc.selection_caveat: BTC and families chosen after knowing recent market; sealed historical data is not equivalent to future prospective validation

uncertainty.bootstrap: daily-return circular block bootstrap, seed20261021, 2000 replicates; block lengths7,14,30 days; one-sided95% mean lower bound
uncertainty.PBO: development only, synchronous daily net-return matrix per family, S=8 contiguous blocks; explicit tail trim policy recorded; Sharpe undefined candidates reported
uncertainty.DSR: only if effective-trial/non-normality assumptions can be justified; otherwise not estimated

research_gate.note: thresholds are declared research screening assumptions, not PM live limits or profit guarantees; failure labels rejected vs insufficient as appropriate

stop_policy: No search expansion after seeing sealed results. Bug fixes logged with previous runs preserved and sealed access contamination disclosed. Do not count neighboring parameters as distinct strategies.
freeze_note: Recorded before any real strategy PnL computation; synthetic unit tests only.
